definitions.gloss: popularization; becoming accessible to the general public
definitions.explanation: the process of something becoming widespread and accessible to ordinary people rather than just elites

examples.japanese: スマートフォンの{大衆化|たいしゅうか}が{進|すす}んだ。
{自動車|じどうしゃ}の{大衆化|たいしゅうか}は{20世紀|にじっせいき}の{大|おお}きな{変化|へんか}だった。
examples.english: The mass popularization of automobiles was a major change of the 20th century.

examples.japanese: {高級|こうきゅう}{料理|りょうり}の{大衆化|たいしゅうか}により、{誰|だれ}でも{楽|たの}しめるようになった。
examples.english: The popularization of high-end cuisine has made it accessible to everyone.

notes:
USAGE:
Used with する to form a verb: {大衆化|たいしゅうか}する (to become popularized).

RELATED TERMS:
- {普及|ふきゅう} (spread, diffusion)
- {一般化|いっぱんか} (generalization)
